+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Serializable utility calls shared by Python and HTTP control clients."""
+
+from typing import Annotated, Any, Literal
+
+import msgspec
+
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.control import ControlContext, ControlError
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.controller import NativeKVController
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.native import Identifier, Target, TokenPosition, validate_target
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.protocol import KvHintsEnvelope
+
+
+class ControlInvocation(msgspec.Struct, forbid_unknown_fields=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    engine_id: Identifier
+    engine_epoch: Identifier
+    consumer: Literal["native", "backend"] = "native"
+    namespace: Identifier | None = None
+
+
+class OperationQuery(msgspec.Struct, forbid_unknown_fields=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    message_id: Identifier
+    action_id: Identifier
+
+
+class MessageQuery(msgspec.Struct, forbid_unknown_fields=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    message_id: Identifier
+
+
+class CancellationQuery(msgspec.Struct, forbid_unknown_fields=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    message_id: Identifier
+    action_id: Identifier
+    operation_id: Annotated[int, msgspec.Meta(ge=1)]
+
+
+class EmptyQuery(msgspec.Struct, forbid_unknown_fields=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    pass
+
+
+class AssociationQuery(msgspec.Struct, forbid_unknown_fields=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    session_id: Identifier | None = None
+    after: tuple[Identifier, Identifier] | None = None
+    revision: TokenPosition | None = None
+    limit: Annotated[int, msgspec.Meta(ge=1, le=4096)] = 256
+
+
+class EventQuery(msgspec.Struct, forbid_unknown_fields=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    stream: Literal["operation", "association"]
+    after: TokenPosition = 0
+    limit: Annotated[int, msgspec.Meta(ge=1, le=4096)] = 256
+
+
+class ResidencyQuery(msgspec.Struct, forbid_unknown_fields=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    target: Target
+    limit: Annotated[int, msgspec.Meta(ge=1, le=4096)] = 256
+
+
+def unwrap_control_reply(reply: dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
+    """Restore structured control errors after safe utility serialization."""
+    if not reply["ok"]:
+        error = reply["error"]
+        raise ControlError(error["code"], error["message"])
+    return reply["result"]
+
+
+class KVControlService:
+    """Scheduler-thread utility facade over the common native control records."""
+
+    def __init__(self, controller: NativeKVController):
+        self.controller = controller
+
+    def call(
+        self, method: str, invocation: dict[str, Any], payload: dict[str, Any]
+    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        try:
+            if (
+                len(msgspec.json.encode(payload))
+                > self.controller.registry.max_envelope_bytes
+            ):
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "invalid_payload", "Control payload byte limit exceeded"
+                )
+            route = msgspec.convert(invocation, type=ControlInvocation)
+            context = ControlContext(
+                route.engine_id,
+                route.engine_epoch,
+                route.consumer,
+                namespace=route.namespace,
+            )
+            self.controller.registry.validate_context(context)
+            if (
+                route.namespace is not None
+                and route.namespace != self.controller.index.namespace
+            ):
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "incompatible", "Invocation targets another cache namespace"
+                )
+            if method == "submit":
+                envelope = msgspec.convert(payload, type=KvHintsEnvelope)
+                result: Any = self.controller.submit(envelope, context)
+            elif method == "operation":
+                query = msgspec.convert(payload, type=OperationQuery)
+                result = self.controller.registry.get(query.message_id, query.action_id)
+                if result is None:
+                    raise ControlError("missing", "Operation is unknown or expired")
+            elif method == "acknowledge":
+                message_query = msgspec.convert(payload, type=MessageQuery)
+                if self.controller.policies is not None:
+                    self.controller.policies.before_acknowledge()
+                self.controller.registry.acknowledge(message_query.message_id)
+                result = {"acknowledged": True}
+            elif method == "capacity":
+                msgspec.convert(payload, type=EmptyQuery)
+                result = self.controller.registry.capacity()
+                transfers = getattr(self.controller.executor, "transfers", None)
+                if transfers is not None:
+                    result["transfers"] = dict(transfers.statistics)
+                result["pending_transfers"] = bool(
+                    getattr(self.controller.executor, "has_pending", False)
+                )
+                result["pending_policy_actions"] = bool(
+                    self.controller.policies is not None
+                    and self.controller.policies.has_pending
+                )
+                if self.controller.policies is not None:
+                    result["policy_errors"] = dict(self.controller.policies.errors)
+            elif route.consumer != "native":
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "unsupported", "Backend path has no native state queries"
+                )
+            elif method == "associations":
+                association_query = msgspec.convert(payload, type=AssociationQuery)
+                result = self.controller.index.query(
+                    session_id=association_query.session_id,
+                    after=association_query.after,
+                    revision=association_query.revision,
+                    limit=association_query.limit,
+                )
+            elif method == "cancel":
+                cancellation = msgspec.convert(payload, type=CancellationQuery)
+                result = self.controller.cancel(
+                    cancellation.message_id,
+                    cancellation.action_id,
+                    cancellation.operation_id,
+                )
+            elif method == "residency":
+                query_residency = msgspec.convert(payload, type=ResidencyQuery)
+                validate_target(query_residency.target)
+                executor = self.controller.executor
+                if executor is None:
+                    raise ControlError("unsupported", "Residency is unavailable")
+                target = self.controller._target(query_residency.target, None)
+                result = executor.residency(
+                    self.controller.index.resolve(target), query_residency.limit
+                )
+                result["engine_id"] = self.controller.registry.engine_id
+                result["engine_epoch"] = self.controller.registry.engine_epoch
+            elif method == "events":
+                event_query = msgspec.convert(payload, type=EventQuery)
+                source = (
+                    self.controller.registry
+                    if event_query.stream == "operation"
+                    else self.controller.index
+                )
+                result = source.events(
+                    event_query.after, epoch=route.engine_epoch, limit=event_query.limit
+                )
+            else:
+                raise ControlError("unsupported", "Unknown control method")
+            return {
+                "ok": True,
+                "result": msgspec.json.decode(msgspec.json.encode(result)),
+            }
+        except ControlError as error:
+            return {"ok": False, "error": {"code": error.code, "message": str(error)}}
+        except (msgspec.ValidationError, TypeError, ValueError) as error:
+            return {
+                "ok": False,
+                "error": {"code": "invalid_payload", "message": str(error)[:4096]},
+            }

+"""Bounded, engine-owned correlation for programmable cache operations."""

+class ControlError(ValueError):
+    """A control request was rejected before changing operation state."""
+
+    def __init__(self, code: str, message: str):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.code = code
+
+
+class OperationStatus(str, Enum):
+    RECEIVED = "received"
+    QUEUED = "queued"
+    ACCEPTED = "accepted"
+    RUNNING = "running"
+    COMPLETED = "completed"
+    PARTIAL = "partial"
+    DEFERRED = "deferred"
+    UNSUPPORTED = "unsupported"
+    MISSING = "missing"
+    FAILED = "failed"
+    CANCELLED = "cancelled"
+    UNCONSUMED = "unconsumed"
+
+    @property
+    def terminal(self) -> bool:
+        return self not in (
+            OperationStatus.RECEIVED,
+            OperationStatus.QUEUED,
+            OperationStatus.ACCEPTED,
+            OperationStatus.RUNNING,
+        )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class OperationReference:

+

+    end_token: int

+    action_id: str
+    consumer: Literal["native", "backend"]
+    operation_id: int
+    status: OperationStatus

+    reason: str = ""

+    blocked_targets: int = 0
+    missing_targets: int = 0

+
+@dataclass
+class _Message:
+    fingerprint: bytes
+    results: dict[str, OperationResult]
+    acknowledged: bool = False
+
+    @property
+    def size(self) -> int:
+        return 0 if self.acknowledged else max(1, len(self.results))
+
+
+def _validate_id(value: object, name: str) -> None:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not 1 <= len(value) <= 256:
+        raise ControlError("invalid_envelope", f"{name} must have 1 to 256 characters")
+
+
+def _validate_json(value: object, depth: int = 0) -> None:
+    if depth > 32:
+        raise ControlError("invalid_envelope", "Payload nesting exceeds 32 levels")
+    if value is None or type(value) in (str, bool, int):
+        return
+    if type(value) is float and math.isfinite(value):
+        return
+    if type(value) is list:
+        for item in value:
+            _validate_json(item, depth + 1)
+        return
+    if type(value) is dict:
+        for key, item in value.items():
+            if type(key) is not str:
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "invalid_envelope", "JSON object keys must be strings"
+                )
+            _validate_json(item, depth + 1)
+        return
+    raise ControlError("invalid_envelope", "Payload must contain finite JSON values")
+
+
+def envelope_fingerprint(
+    envelope: KvHintsEnvelope,
+    context: ControlContext,
+    *,
+    max_actions: int,
+    max_bytes: int,
+) -> bytes:
+    """Validate the wrapper and opaque JSON, without interpreting action payloads."""
+    if not isinstance(envelope, KvHintsEnvelope):
+        raise ControlError("invalid_envelope", "Expected KvHintsEnvelope")
+    for name in ("protocol_version", "message_id"):
+        _validate_id(getattr(envelope, name), name)
+    if not isinstance(envelope.actions, list) or len(envelope.actions) > max_actions:

+                    SharePayload,

+    def _check_policy_declaration(

+            )

+        results = []

+            "unsupported_action": OperationStatus.UNSUPPORTED,
+            "unsupported_version": OperationStatus.UNSUPPORTED,
+            "missing": OperationStatus.MISSING,
+            "missing_association": OperationStatus.MISSING,
+            "capacity": OperationStatus.DEFERRED,
+            "busy": OperationStatus.DEFERRED,
+        }.get(error.code, OperationStatus.FAILED)

+"""One native dispatcher for RFC primitives and the legacy semantic profile."""
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Literal, cast
+
+import msgspec
+
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.actions import (
+    PRIMITIVE_VERSION,
+    PRIMITIVES,
+    CopyTo,
+    MoveTo,
+    Primitive,
+    SetPriority,
+)
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.control import ControlError, OperationResult, OperationStatus
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.native import (
+    ActionCapability,
+    DemotePayload,
+    HashTarget,
+    NativePayload,
+    PrefetchPayload,
+    RequestTarget,
+    StorePayload,
+    Target,
+    parse_native_action,
+    validate_target,
+)

+    from vllm.v1.kv_hints.controller import NativeKVController

+@dataclass
+class _Consumer:
+    payload_type: type[Primitive]
+    when: Callable[[Primitive], Literal["ingress", "successful_completion"]]
+
+
+def _phase(payload: Primitive) -> Literal["ingress", "successful_completion"]:
+    return (
+        "successful_completion"
+        if isinstance(payload, SetPriority) or payload.src.tier == "gpu"
+        else "ingress"
+    )
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _DeferredAction:
+    operation: OperationResult
+    payload: Primitive
+    scope: LogicalResolution | None
+    request: Request
+    generation: int
+
+
+class KvHintDispatcher:
+    def __init__(self, controller: "NativeKVController"):
+        self.controller = controller
+        self._consumers: dict[tuple[str, str], _Consumer] = {}
+        self._pending: dict[str, list[_DeferredAction]] = {}
+        for name, payload_type in PRIMITIVES.items():
+            self.register(name, PRIMITIVE_VERSION, payload_type, when=_phase)
+
+    def register(
+        self,
+        name: str,
+        version: str,
+        payload_type: type[Primitive],
+        *,
+        when: Callable[[Primitive], Literal["ingress", "successful_completion"]],
+    ) -> None:
+        key = name, version
+        if key in self._consumers:
+            raise ValueError(f"KV hint consumer already registered: {key}")
+        self._consumers[key] = _Consumer(payload_type, when)
+
+    def parse(self, action: KvHintAction) -> NativePayload | Primitive:
+        if not action.action_type.startswith("vllm."):
+            return parse_native_action(action)
+        consumer = self._consumers.get((action.action_type, action.action_version))
+        if consumer is None:
+            raise ControlError("unsupported", "Unsupported native primitive or version")
+        try:
+            payload = msgspec.convert(
+                action.payload, type=consumer.payload_type, strict=True
+            )
+        except (msgspec.ValidationError, ValueError) as error:
+            raise ControlError("invalid_payload", str(error)) from error
+        if not isinstance(payload.target, str):
+            validate_target(payload.target)
+        return payload
+
+    def lower(
+        self, payload: CopyTo | MoveTo, target: Target | str
+    ) -> DemotePayload | StorePayload | PrefetchPayload:
+        if isinstance(target, str):
+            target = HashTarget(self.controller.index.namespace, ())
+        local = self.controller.registry.engine_id
+        if any(
+            location.engine_id not in (None, local)
+            for location in (payload.src, payload.dst)
+        ):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "unsupported", "Remote engines must approve their own COPY"
+            )
+        src, dst = payload.src.tier, payload.dst.tier
+        if src == "gpu" and dst in ("cpu", "mooncake"):
+            cls = DemotePayload if isinstance(payload, MoveTo) else StorePayload
+            return cls(target, cast(Literal["cpu", "mooncake"], dst))
+        if src in ("cpu", "mooncake") and dst == "gpu" and isinstance(payload, CopyTo):
+            return PrefetchPayload(target, cast(Literal["cpu", "mooncake"], src))
+        raise ControlError(
+            "unsupported",
+            "Requires local G1/cold COPY or G1-to-cold MOVE; "
+            "cold deletion is unsupported",
+        )
+
+    def execute(
+        self,
+        operation: OperationResult,
+        payload: Primitive,
+        *,
+        request_id: str | None,
+        resolution: LogicalResolution | None,
+        attached: bool,
+        owners: tuple[str, ...] = (),
+    ) -> None:

+        if executor is None:
+            raise ControlError("unsupported", "No primitive executor configured")

+        if isinstance(payload, (CopyTo, MoveTo)):

+                ("prefetch", lowered.source)
+                if isinstance(lowered, PrefetchPayload)
+                else ("demote", lowered.destination)
+            )
+            if not any(
+                c.action_type == kind and tier in c.tiers
+                for c in executor.capabilities()
+            ):
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "unsupported",
+                    "No adapter supports the requested primitive direction",
+                )
+        if attached and consumer.when(payload) == "successful_completion":
+            observer = self.controller.request_observer
+            if observer is None:
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "unsupported", "Request lifecycle binding is unavailable"
+                )
+            request = observer.request(RequestTarget("$request"), request_id)
+            pending = self._pending.get(request.request_id)
+            if pending and pending[0].request is not request:
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "busy", "Request ID is already bound to another lifecycle"
+                )
+            if isinstance(
+                payload.target, RequestTarget
+            ) and payload.target.request_id not in ("$request", request.request_id):
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "unsupported",
+                    "Deferred request selectors must name the bound request",
+                )
+            scope = resolution
+            if scope is None and not isinstance(payload.target, (str, RequestTarget)):
+                scope = self.controller.index.resolve(payload.target)
+                executor.validate_scope(scope)
+            # Pending actions share the bounded registry admission.
+            work = _DeferredAction(
+                operation,
+                payload,
+                scope,
+                request,
+                executor.manager.get_transfer_manager().generation,
+            )
+            self._pending.setdefault(request.request_id, []).append(work)
+            self.controller.registry.update(
+                operation,
+                OperationStatus.QUEUED,
+                reason="Awaiting successful request completion",
+            )
+            return
+        self._execute_now(
+            operation, payload, resolution, request_id=request_id, owners=owners
+        )
+
+    def _execute_now(
+        self,
+        operation: OperationResult,
+        payload: Primitive,
+        scope: LogicalResolution | None,
+        *,
+        request_id: str | None = None,
+        request: Request | None = None,
+        owners: tuple[str, ...] = (),
+    ) -> None:
+        controller = self.controller
+        executor = controller.executor
+        assert executor is not None
+        if scope is None:
+            if request is not None and isinstance(payload.target, RequestTarget):
+                observer = controller.request_observer
+                assert observer is not None
+                scope = controller.index.resolve(
+                    observer.resolve_finished(request, payload.target)
+                )
+            elif request is not None and isinstance(payload.target, str):
+                scope = executor.request_scope(request, payload.target)
+            elif payload.target == "request_cached":
+                if request_id is None or controller.request_observer is None:
+                    raise ControlError(
+                        "unsupported", "request_cached requires a bound request"
+                    )
+                request = controller.request_observer.request(
+                    RequestTarget("$request"), request_id
+                )
+                scope = executor.request_scope(request, "request_cached")
+            else:
+                assert not isinstance(payload.target, str)
+                scope = controller.index.resolve(
+                    controller._target(payload.target, request_id)
+                )
+        executor.validate_scope(scope)
+        if payload.target == "request_cached" and not any(
+            p.blocks for p in scope.prefixes
+        ):
+            raise ControlError("missing", "No cached copies held by the bound request")
+        if isinstance(payload, SetPriority):
+            if (
+                controller.policies is not None
+                and operation.origin is None
+                and payload.value is not None
+            ):

+            executor.apply_priority(operation, payload, scope, request, owners)
+            return
+        # The logical snapshot is authoritative; lowering does not resolve it again.
+        target = HashTarget(
+            scope.namespace,
+            tuple(b for p in scope.prefixes for b in p.blocks),
+            scope.start_token,
+            scope.end_token,
+        )
+        lowered = self.lower(payload, target)
+        if controller.policies is not None and operation.origin is None:
+            controller.policies.before_explicit(lowered, scope)
+        executor.submit(operation, lowered, scope)
+
+    def finish(self, request: Request) -> None:
+        pending = self._pending.pop(request.request_id, ())
+        for work in pending:
+            try:
+                if work.request is not request or request.status not in (
+                    RequestStatus.FINISHED_STOPPED,
+                    RequestStatus.FINISHED_LENGTH_CAPPED,
+                ):
+                    self.controller.registry.update(
+                        work.operation,
+                        OperationStatus.CANCELLED,
+                        reason="Request did not finish successfully",
+                    )
+                    continue
+                executor = self.controller.executor
+                assert executor is not None
+                if (
+                    executor.manager.get_transfer_manager().generation
+                    != work.generation
+                ):
+                    self.controller.registry.update(
+                        work.operation,
+                        OperationStatus.CANCELLED,
+                        reason="Cache reset invalidated the queued action",
+                    )
+                    continue
+                self._execute_now(
+                    work.operation, work.payload, work.scope, request=request
+                )
+            except ControlError as error:
+                self.controller.record_error(work.operation, error)
+            except Exception as error:
+                self.controller._record_failure(
+                    work.operation, OperationStatus.FAILED, type(error).__name__
+                )
+
+    def cancel(self, operation_id: int) -> None:
+        for request_id, works in tuple(self._pending.items()):
+            remaining = [w for w in works if w.operation.operation_id != operation_id]
+            if remaining:
+                self._pending[request_id] = remaining
+            else:
+                del self._pending[request_id]
+
+    def capabilities(self) -> tuple[ActionCapability, ...]:
+        executor = self.controller.executor
+        if executor is None:
+            return ()
+        targets: tuple[
+            Literal["hashes", "session", "request", "request_cached"], ...
+        ] = (
+            ("hashes", "session", "request", "request_cached")
+            if self.controller.request_observer is not None
+            else ("hashes", "session")
+        )
+        result = [
+            ActionCapability(
+                "vllm.set_priority",
+                PRIMITIVE_VERSION,
+                targets,
+                ("gpu",),
+                True,
+                (
+                    "Copy-lifetime claims; attached actions apply at "
+                    "successful completion",
+                    "request_cached requires a request binding",
+                ),
+            )
+        ]
+        for kind in ("vllm.copy_to", "vllm.move_to"):
+            selected = [
+                c
+                for c in executor.capabilities()
+                if c.action_type == "demote"

+                    (f"{tier}->gpu" if c.action_type == "prefetch" else f"gpu->{tier}")
+                    for c in selected
+                    for tier in c.tiers

+            )
+            limitations = tuple(
+                dict.fromkeys(note for c in selected for note in c.limitations)
+            ) + (
+                "Attached GPU sources execute at successful completion; "
+                "cold COPY at ingress",
+                "No remote G1 allocation or cold-tier deletion",
+            )
+            result.append(
+                ActionCapability(
+                    kind,
+                    PRIMITIVE_VERSION,
+                    targets,
+                    tiers,
+                    True,
+                    limitations,
+                    directions,
+                )
+            )
+        return tuple(result)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Payload schemas for vLLM's native consumer of the merged hint envelope."""
+
+import math
+from typing import Annotated, Any, Literal, TypeAlias
+
+import msgspec
+
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.control import ControlError
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.protocol import KvHintAction
+
+Identifier: TypeAlias = Annotated[str, msgspec.Meta(min_length=1, max_length=256)]
+TokenPosition: TypeAlias = Annotated[int, msgspec.Meta(ge=0)]
+PositiveSeconds: TypeAlias = Annotated[float, msgspec.Meta(gt=0)]
+Tier: TypeAlias = Literal["gpu", "cpu", "mooncake"]
+
+NATIVE_PROTOCOL_VERSION = "0.1"
+NATIVE_ACTION_VERSION = "1"
+
+
+class ContentSpan(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, forbid_unknown_fields=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    """Logical group content; no allocator block IDs or residency claim."""
+
+    block_hash: Annotated[str, msgspec.Meta(pattern="^[0-9a-f]{2,128}$")]
+    group_id: Annotated[int, msgspec.Meta(ge=0, le=(1 << 32) - 1)]
+    start_token: TokenPosition
+    end_token: TokenPosition
+
+
+class HashTarget(  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    msgspec.Struct,
+    tag="hashes",
+    tag_field="kind",
+    frozen=True,
+    forbid_unknown_fields=True,
+):
+    namespace: Identifier
+    blocks: Annotated[tuple[ContentSpan, ...], msgspec.Meta(max_length=16384)]
+    start_token: TokenPosition = 0
+    end_token: TokenPosition | None = None
+
+
+class SessionTarget(  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    msgspec.Struct,
+    tag="session",
+    tag_field="kind",
+    frozen=True,
+    forbid_unknown_fields=True,
+):
+    session_id: Identifier
+    continuation_id: Identifier | None = None
+    start_token: TokenPosition = 0
+    end_token: TokenPosition | None = None
+
+
+class RequestTarget(  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    msgspec.Struct,
+    tag="request",
+    tag_field="kind",
+    frozen=True,
+    forbid_unknown_fields=True,
+):
+    request_id: Identifier
+    start_token: TokenPosition = 0
+    end_token: TokenPosition | None = None
+
+
+Target: TypeAlias = HashTarget | SessionTarget | RequestTarget
+
+
+class RetainPayload(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, forbid_unknown_fields=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    target: Target
+    owner_id: Identifier
+    declaration_id: Identifier
+    priority: Annotated[int, msgspec.Meta(ge=0, le=100)] = 0
+    ttl_seconds: PositiveSeconds | None = None
+    tier: Tier = "gpu"
+    scope: Literal["snapshot", "follow_growth"] = "snapshot"
+
+
+class ReleasePayload(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, forbid_unknown_fields=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    owner_id: Identifier
+    declaration_id: Identifier
+
+
+class EvictPayload(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, forbid_unknown_fields=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    target: Target
+    tier: Tier = "gpu"
+
+
+class DemotePayload(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, forbid_unknown_fields=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    target: Target
+    destination: Literal["cpu", "mooncake"]
+
+
+class PrefetchPayload(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, forbid_unknown_fields=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    target: Target
+    source: Literal["cpu", "mooncake"]
+
+
+class SharePayload(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, forbid_unknown_fields=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    target: Target
+    destination_engine_id: Identifier
+
+
+class StorePayload(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    """Internal lowering of COPY from G1; not a legacy wire action."""
+
+    target: Target
+    destination: Literal["cpu", "mooncake"]
+
+
+class ParentPrefix(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, forbid_unknown_fields=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    session_id: Identifier
+    continuation_id: Identifier
+    end_token: TokenPosition
+
+
+class AssociatePayload(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, forbid_unknown_fields=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    session_id: Identifier
+    continuation_id: Identifier
+    expected_revision: TokenPosition
+    target: HashTarget | RequestTarget
+    task_parent_id: Identifier | None = None
+    parent_prefix: ParentPrefix | None = None
+    observe_growth: bool = False
+
+
+class FinishTaskPayload(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, forbid_unknown_fields=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    session_id: Identifier
+    expected_revision: TokenPosition
+
+
+class SignalPayload(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, forbid_unknown_fields=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    target: Target
+    signal: Literal["tool_wait", "resume", "importance", "resume_prediction"]
+    importance: Annotated[int, msgspec.Meta(ge=0, le=100)] | None = None
+    resume_after_seconds: PositiveSeconds | None = None
+
+
+NativePayload: TypeAlias = (
+    RetainPayload
+    | ReleasePayload
+    | EvictPayload
+    | DemotePayload
+    | PrefetchPayload
+    | SharePayload
+    | AssociatePayload
+    | FinishTaskPayload
+    | SignalPayload
+    | StorePayload
+)
+
+# These are built-in semantics, not a user-defined hint-handler registry.
+_PAYLOAD_TYPES: dict[str, type[NativePayload]] = {
+    "retain": RetainPayload,
+    "release": ReleasePayload,
+    "evict": EvictPayload,
+    "demote": DemotePayload,
+    "prefetch": PrefetchPayload,
+    "share": SharePayload,
+    "associate": AssociatePayload,
+    "finish_task": FinishTaskPayload,
+    "signal": SignalPayload,
+}
+
+
+class ActionCapability(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    action_type: str
+    action_version: str
+    targets: tuple[Literal["hashes", "session", "request", "request_cached"], ...]
+    tiers: tuple[Tier, ...]
+    request_free: bool
+    limitations: tuple[str, ...] = ()
+    directions: tuple[str, ...] = ()
+
+
+class ConsumerCapabilities(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    engine_id: str
+    engine_epoch: str
+    consumer: Literal["native", "backend"]
+    protocol_versions: tuple[str, ...]
+    actions: tuple[ActionCapability, ...]
+    namespace: str
+    result_ttl_seconds: float
+    max_actions: int
+    max_envelope_bytes: int
+    cache_profile: dict[str, Any] | None = None
+
+
+def validate_target(target: Target) -> None:
+    if target.end_token is not None and target.end_token <= target.start_token:
+        raise ControlError("invalid_payload", "Target end must be greater than start")
+    if isinstance(target, HashTarget):
+        seen: set[tuple[int, int, int]] = set()
+        for block in target.blocks:
+            if len(block.block_hash) % 2:
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "invalid_payload", "Block hash must encode whole bytes"
+                )
+            if block.end_token <= block.start_token:
+                raise ControlError("invalid_payload", "Content span must be nonempty")
+            position = (block.group_id, block.start_token, block.end_token)
+            if position in seen:
+                raise ControlError("invalid_payload", "Duplicate content position")
+            seen.add(position)
+        per_group: dict[int, list[ContentSpan]] = {}
+        for block in target.blocks:
+            per_group.setdefault(block.group_id, []).append(block)
+        for blocks in per_group.values():
+            ordered = sorted(
+                blocks, key=lambda block: (block.start_token, block.end_token)
+            )
+            if any(
+                a.end_token > b.start_token and a.start_token != b.start_token
+                for a, b in zip(ordered, ordered[1:])
+            ):
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "invalid_payload", "Content spans overlap in a group"
+                )
+
+
+def parse_native_action(action: KvHintAction) -> NativePayload:
+    """Validate a native payload without resolving content or approving resources."""
+    payload_type = _PAYLOAD_TYPES.get(action.action_type)
+    if payload_type is None:
+        raise ControlError(
+            "unsupported_action", f"Unknown native action {action.action_type}"
+        )
+    if action.action_version != NATIVE_ACTION_VERSION:
+        raise ControlError("unsupported_version", "Unsupported native action version")
+    try:
+        payload = msgspec.convert(action.payload, type=payload_type, strict=True)
+    except msgspec.ValidationError as error:
+        raise ControlError("invalid_payload", str(error)) from error
+    if isinstance(
+        payload,
+        (
+            RetainPayload,
+            EvictPayload,
+            DemotePayload,
+            PrefetchPayload,
+            SharePayload,
+            AssociatePayload,
+            SignalPayload,
+        ),
+    ):
+        validate_target(payload.target)
+    if isinstance(payload, RetainPayload):
+        if payload.ttl_seconds is not None and not math.isfinite(payload.ttl_seconds):
+            raise ControlError("invalid_payload", "Retention TTL must be finite")
+        if payload.scope == "follow_growth" and not (
+            isinstance(payload.target, SessionTarget)
+            and payload.target.continuation_id is not None
+        ):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "invalid_payload", "Growth requires an explicit continuation"
+            )
+    if (
+        isinstance(payload, AssociatePayload)
+        and payload.observe_growth
+        and not isinstance(payload.target, RequestTarget)
+    ):
+        raise ControlError(
+            "invalid_payload", "Request growth requires a request target"
+        )
+    if (
+        isinstance(payload, SignalPayload)
+        and payload.resume_after_seconds is not None
+        and not math.isfinite(payload.resume_after_seconds)
+    ):
+        raise ControlError("invalid_payload", "Resume prediction must be finite")
+    if (
+        isinstance(payload, AssociatePayload)
+        and payload.task_parent_id == payload.session_id
+    ):
+        raise ControlError("invalid_payload", "A task cannot parent itself")
+    return payload

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Read-only policy observations and proposal-only startup extension points."""
+
+import math
+from collections import OrderedDict
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Literal, TypeAlias
+
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.actions import (
+    CacheLocation,
+    CopyTo,
+    MoveTo,
+    Primitive,
+    SetPriority,
+)
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.control import OperationResult
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.native import (
+    ContentSpan,
+    DemotePayload,
+    EvictPayload,
+    HashTarget,
+    PrefetchPayload,
+    ReleasePayload,
+    RequestTarget,
+    RetainPayload,
+    SessionTarget,
+    SharePayload,
+    SignalPayload,
+    Target,
+)
+
+PolicyAction: TypeAlias = (
+    RetainPayload
+    | ReleasePayload
+    | EvictPayload
+    | DemotePayload
+    | PrefetchPayload
+    | SharePayload
+    | Primitive
+)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class RequestDemand:
+    request_id: str
+    session_id: str | None
+    waiting_seconds: float
+    arrival_order: int
+    waiting: bool
+    held_blocks: int
+    estimated_blocks: int
+    remaining_output_tokens: int = 0
+    cached_tokens: int = 0
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class CacheObservation:
+    now: float
+    total_blocks: int
+    free_blocks: int
+    referenced_blocks: int
+    load_reservations: int
+    transfer_source_blocks: int
+    retention_declarations: int
+    requests: tuple[RequestDemand, ...]
+    session_blocks: tuple[tuple[str | None, int], ...]
+    truncated_requests: bool = False
+    cached_blocks: int = 0
+    reclaimable_cached_blocks: int = 0
+    pending_policy_actions: int = 0
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PolicySignal:
+    payload: SignalPayload
+    target: Target
+    owner_id: str
+    request_id: str | None
+    owners: tuple[str, ...] = ()
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PolicyProposal:
+    action: PolicyAction
+    not_before: float = 0.0
+    content_keys: frozenset[tuple[int, str]] = frozenset()
+    wait_for_admission: bool = False
+    skip_if_running: bool = False
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PolicyDecision:
+    proposals: tuple[PolicyProposal, ...] = ()
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class RequestGuidance:
+    request_id: str
+    admit: bool = True
+    score: float = 0.0
+    reason: str = ""
+    reserve_running_growth: bool = False
+
+
+class KVPolicy:
+    """Policies receive values, never a scheduler, allocator or connector."""
+
+    uses_scheduler_guidance = False
+    # None preserves delivery of every signal to third-party policies.
+    consumed_signals: frozenset[str] | None = None
+
+    def needs_request_observation(self, payload: SignalPayload) -> bool:
+        """Opt out only when a signal needs no request or session demand values."""
+        return True
+
+    def needs_request_observation_for_view(
+        self, payload: SignalPayload, view: CacheObservation
+    ) -> bool:
+        """Refine request reads using physical counters before demand queries."""
+        return self.needs_request_observation(payload)
+
+    def on_signal(
+        self,
+        signal: PolicySignal,
+        view: CacheObservation,
+    ) -> PolicyDecision | None:
+        return None
+
+    def guidance(self, view: CacheObservation) -> tuple[RequestGuidance, ...]:
+        return ()
+
+    def cleanup(self, owners: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    def on_result(
+        self,
+        action: PolicyAction,
+        result: OperationResult,
+        *,
+        owner_id: str,
+        owners: tuple[str, ...],
+        elapsed_seconds: float,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Observe completed proposals without obtaining allocator access."""
+        pass
+
+
+def _positive(value: float, name: str) -> None:
+    if not math.isfinite(value) or value <= 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be positive and finite")
+
+
+class RetentionPolicy(KVPolicy):
+    consumed_signals = frozenset({"importance", "resume"})
+
+    def needs_request_observation(self, payload: SignalPayload) -> bool:
+        return False
+
+    def __init__(self, priority: int = 50, ttl_seconds: float = 30.0):
+        if type(priority) is not int or not 0 <= priority <= 100:
+            raise ValueError("Retention priority must be between 0 and 100")
+        _positive(ttl_seconds, "ttl_seconds")
+        self.priority = priority
+        self.ttl_seconds = ttl_seconds
+        self._revision = 0
+
+    def on_signal(
+        self, signal: PolicySignal, view: CacheObservation
+    ) -> PolicyDecision | None:
+        payload = signal.payload
+        if payload.signal not in ("importance", "resume"):
+            return None
+        priority = (
+            payload.importance if payload.importance is not None else self.priority
+        )
+        self._revision += 1
+        return PolicyDecision(
+            (
+                PolicyProposal(
+                    SetPriority(
+                        signal.target,
+                        "local_g1",
+                        signal.owner_id,
+                        self._revision,
+                        priority,
+                        self.ttl_seconds,
+                    ),
+                    skip_if_running=payload.signal == "resume",
+                ),
+            )
+        )
+
+
+class ToolWaitPolicy(KVPolicy):
+    consumed_signals = frozenset({"tool_wait", "resume", "resume_prediction"})
+    signal_updates_guidance = False
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        tier: Literal["cpu", "mooncake"] = "mooncake",
+        lead_seconds: float = 0.1,
+        min_pressure: float = 0.0,
+        max_stored_blocks: int = 16384,
+        min_pause_seconds: float = 0.5,
+        prefetch_on_admission: bool = False,
+        consider_pause_duration: bool = True,
+    ):
+        if tier not in ("cpu", "mooncake"):
+            raise ValueError("Movement policy requires CPU or Mooncake")
+        if not math.isfinite(lead_seconds) or lead_seconds < 0:
+            raise ValueError("lead_seconds must be nonnegative and finite")
+        if not math.isfinite(min_pressure) or not 0 <= min_pressure <= 1:
+            raise ValueError("min_pressure must be between zero and one")
+        self.tier = tier
+        self.lead_seconds = lead_seconds
+        self.min_pressure = min_pressure
+        if not math.isfinite(min_pause_seconds) or min_pause_seconds < 0:
+            raise ValueError("min_pause_seconds must be nonnegative and finite")
+        self.min_pause_seconds = min_pause_seconds
+        self.prefetch_on_admission = prefetch_on_admission
+        self.uses_scheduler_guidance = prefetch_on_admission
+        self.consider_pause_duration = consider_pause_duration
+        if type(max_stored_blocks) is not int or max_stored_blocks < 1:
+            raise ValueError("max_stored_blocks must be positive")
+        self.max_stored_blocks = max_stored_blocks
+        self._stored: OrderedDict[str, tuple[HashTarget, tuple[str, ...], int]] = (
+            OrderedDict()
+        )
+        self._known_stored: OrderedDict[tuple[str, ContentSpan], None] = OrderedDict()
+        self._stored_blocks = 0
+        self._copy_seconds_per_byte: float | None = None
+        self._store_seconds = 0.0
+        self._load_seconds = 0.0
+        self._kept: OrderedDict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = OrderedDict()
+
+    def _worth_moving(
+        self, pause: float | None, view: CacheObservation | None = None
+    ) -> bool:
+        if (
+            view is not None
+            and self.consider_pause_duration
+            and view.referenced_blocks < self.min_pressure * view.total_blocks
+        ):
+            return False
+        minimum_window = max(
+            self.min_pause_seconds, self._store_seconds + self._load_seconds
+        )
+        return (
+            not self.consider_pause_duration
+            or pause is None
+            or pause > minimum_window
+            or (
+                view is not None
+                and self._has_admission_pressure(view)
+                and any(
+                    r.waiting and r.waiting_seconds > minimum_window
+                    for r in view.requests
+                )
+            )
+        )
+
+    def _has_admission_pressure(self, view: CacheObservation) -> bool:
+        return (
+            self.prefetch_on_admission
+            and view.referenced_blocks > 0
+            and view.referenced_blocks >= self.min_pressure * view.total_blocks
+        )
+
+    def needs_request_observation(self, payload: SignalPayload) -> bool:
+        return payload.signal == "tool_wait" and self._worth_moving(
+            payload.resume_after_seconds
+        )
+
+    def needs_request_observation_for_view(
+        self, payload: SignalPayload, view: CacheObservation
+    ) -> bool:
+        if (
+            payload.signal == "tool_wait"
+            and self.consider_pause_duration
+            and view.referenced_blocks < self.min_pressure * view.total_blocks
+        ):
+            return False
+        return self.needs_request_observation(payload) or (
+            payload.signal == "tool_wait" and self._has_admission_pressure(view)
+        )
+
+    def on_result(
+        self,
+        action: PolicyAction,
+        result: OperationResult,
+        *,
+        owner_id: str,
+        owners: tuple[str, ...],
+        elapsed_seconds: float,
+    ) -> None:
+        if (
+            isinstance(action, CopyTo)
+            and action.dst.tier == "gpu"
+            and result.transferred_bytes
+            and "gpu_content_registered" in result.completed_steps
+            and elapsed_seconds > 0
+        ):
+            observed = elapsed_seconds / result.transferred_bytes
+            previous = self._copy_seconds_per_byte
+            self._copy_seconds_per_byte = (
+                observed if previous is None else 0.75 * previous + 0.25 * observed
+            )
+            self._load_seconds = max(
+                elapsed_seconds, 0.75 * self._load_seconds + 0.25 * elapsed_seconds
+            )
+        if not isinstance(action, MoveTo) or result.namespace is None:
+            return
+        if result.transferred_bytes and "cold_copy_stored" in result.completed_steps:
+            self._store_seconds = max(
+                elapsed_seconds, 0.75 * self._store_seconds + 0.25 * elapsed_seconds
+            )
+        intended = tuple(
+            ContentSpan(o.block_hash, o.group_id, o.start_token, o.end_token)
+            for o in result.target_outcomes
+            if (o.block_hash is not None and o.group_id is not None)
+        )
+        for outcome in result.target_outcomes:
+            if (
+                outcome.block_hash is None

+        self._importance = {
+            key: item for key, item in self._importance.items() if item[1] > now
+        }

+    ) -> PolicyDecision | None:
+        if signal.payload.signal != "importance" or signal.payload.importance is None:
+            return None
+        target = signal.payload.target
+        if isinstance(target, SessionTarget):
+            key = "session", target.session_id
+        elif isinstance(target, RequestTarget) and signal.request_id is not None:
+            key = "request", signal.request_id
+        else:
+            return None
+        self._expire(view.now)
+        if key not in self._importance and len(self._importance) >= self.max_states:
+            raise ValueError("Quota importance state capacity exhausted")
+        self._importance[key] = (
+            signal.payload.importance,
+            view.now + self.importance_ttl,
+        )

+    def guidance(self, view: CacheObservation) -> tuple[RequestGuidance, ...]:
+        self._expire(view.now)
+        weights = dict(self.shares)
+        for request in view.requests:
+            weights.setdefault(request.session_id or "", 1.0)
+        total_weight = sum(weights.values()) or 1.0
+        occupied = dict(view.session_blocks)
+        growth = sum(
+            max(0, r.estimated_blocks - r.held_blocks)
+            for r in view.requests
+            if not r.waiting
+        )
+        result = []
+        for request in view.requests:
+            if not request.waiting:
+                continue
+            share = weights[request.session_id or ""] / total_weight
+            demand = occupied.get(request.session_id, 0) + max(
+                0, request.estimated_blocks - request.held_blocks
+            )
+            admit = request.waiting_seconds >= self.max_wait_seconds or demand <= max(
+                1, int(view.total_blocks * share)
+            )
+            available = max(0, view.free_blocks - growth)
+            additional = max(0, request.estimated_blocks - request.held_blocks)
+            if (
+                self.borrow_idle_capacity
+                and not occupied.get(request.session_id, 0)
+                and additional <= available
+            ):
+                admit = True
+            if self.reserve_running_growth:
+                admit = admit and additional <= available
+            importance = max(
+                self._importance.get(("request", request.request_id), (0, 0))[0],
+                self._importance.get(("session", request.session_id or ""), (0, 0))[0],
+            )
+            score = importance / 100 + request.waiting_seconds / self.aging_seconds
+            score += self.reuse_score_weight * request.cached_tokens / 1024

+                RequestGuidance(
+                    request.request_id,
+                    admit,
+                    score,
+                    "" if admit else "Session quota",
+                    self.reserve_running_growth,
+                )
+            )

+
+    def cleanup(self, owners: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:

+def placement(action: object) -> str:
+    if isinstance(action, (RetainPayload, PrefetchPayload)):
+        return "gpu"
+    if isinstance(action, SetPriority):
+        return "gpu" if action.value is not None else ""
+    if isinstance(action, CopyTo):

+class KVPlanComposer:
+    """Compose advisory scores; physical conflicts remain engine-checked."""
+
+    def compose(
+        self, proposals: tuple[PolicyProposal, ...], view: CacheObservation
+    ) -> tuple[bool, ...]:
+        """Select compatible proposals in configured policy order."""
+        accepted: list[tuple[frozenset[tuple[int, str]], str]] = []
+        choices = []
+        for proposal in proposals:
+            action = proposal.action
+            keys = proposal.content_keys
+            destination = placement(action)
+            conflict = bool(destination) and any(
+                keys.intersection(previous) and destination != previous_destination
+                for previous, previous_destination in accepted
+            )
+            choices.append(not conflict)
+            if destination and not conflict:
+                accepted.append((keys, destination))
+        return tuple(choices)
+
+    def combine(
+        self, guidance: tuple[RequestGuidance, ...]
+    ) -> tuple[RequestGuidance, ...]:
+        merged: dict[str, RequestGuidance] = {}
+        for proposal in guidance:
+            if not math.isfinite(proposal.score):
+                raise ValueError("Policy scores must be finite")
+            previous = merged.get(proposal.request_id)
+            merged[proposal.request_id] = (
+                proposal
+                if previous is None
+                else RequestGuidance(
+                    proposal.request_id,
+                    previous.admit and proposal.admit,
+                    previous.score + proposal.score,
+                    previous.reason or proposal.reason,
+                    previous.reserve_running_growth or proposal.reserve_running_growth,
+                )
+            )
+        return tuple(merged.values())

+class KVRetentionPriority:
+    """Project declaration changes into the existing pool's eviction ordering."""
+
+    def __init__(self, pool: BlockPool, declarations: RetentionDeclarations):
+        self.declarations = declarations
+        self.pool = pool
+        self.copies = KVCachePriority()
+        self._version: tuple[int, int] | None = None
+        self._priorities: dict[BlockHashWithGroupId, int] = {}
+        self.synchronize()
+        pool.configure_retention(
+            self.priority,
+            self.synchronize,
+            copy_priority=self.copies.priority,
+            forget_priority=self.copies.forget,
+        )
+
+    def priority(self, key: BlockHashWithGroupId) -> int | None:
+        return self._priorities.get(key)
+
+    def synchronize(self) -> tuple[BlockHashWithGroupId, ...]:
+        changed_copies = self.copies.take_changes()
+        if self.pool._retention_queue is not None:
+            for block_id in changed_copies:
+                self.pool._retention_queue.cache_changed(self.pool.blocks[block_id])
+        version, snapshot = self.declarations.priority_snapshot()
+        if version == self._version:
+            return ()
+        updated = {
+            make_block_hash_with_group_id(
+                BlockHash(bytes.fromhex(block_hash)), group
+            ): p
+            for (group, block_hash), p in snapshot.items()
+        }
+        changed = tuple(
+            key
+            for key in self._priorities.keys() | updated.keys()
+            if self._priorities.get(key) != updated.get(key)
+        )
+        self._priorities = updated
+        self._version = version

+"""Independent retention declarations; no physical cache references or leases."""
+
+import heapq
+import time
+from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import TypeAlias
+
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.control import ControlError
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.native import HashTarget, RetainPayload, SessionTarget

+    ContentKey,
+    ContinuationKey,
+    LogicalResolution,
+    SessionPrefixIndex,
+    content_key,
+)
+
+DeclarationKey: TypeAlias = tuple[str, str]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class RetainDeclaration:
+    owner_id: str
+    declaration_id: str
+    generation: int
+    priority: int
+    expires_at: float | None
+    target: HashTarget | SessionTarget
+    follows_growth: bool
+    continuation_incarnation: int | None
+    snapshot: LogicalResolution
+    policy_name: str | None = None
+
+
+class RetentionDeclarations:
+    """Eviction biases shared by logical content, never correctness references.
+
+    Follow-growth lookup uses the common index's current membership. It does not
+    copy or periodically rescan every continuation as requests extend prefixes.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        index: SessionPrefixIndex,
+        *,
+        max_declarations: int = 4096,
+        max_snapshot_entries: int = 262144,
+        clock: Callable[[], float] = time.monotonic,
+    ):
+        if any(
+            type(n) is not int or n < 1
+            for n in (max_declarations, max_snapshot_entries)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("Declaration limits must be positive integers")
+        self.index = index
+        self.max_declarations = max_declarations
+        self.max_snapshot_entries = max_snapshot_entries
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._generation = 0
+        self._snapshot_count = 0
+        self._declarations: dict[DeclarationKey, RetainDeclaration] = {}
+        self._owners: dict[str, set[DeclarationKey]] = {}
+        self._snapshot_keys: dict[DeclarationKey, set[ContentKey]] = {}
+        self._snapshot_sizes: dict[DeclarationKey, int] = {}
+        self._by_content: dict[ContentKey, dict[DeclarationKey, int]] = {}
+        self._following: dict[ContinuationKey, set[DeclarationKey]] = {}
+        self._expiry: list[tuple[float, int, DeclarationKey]] = []
+        self._projection_version: tuple[int, int] | None = None
+        self._projection: Mapping[ContentKey, int] = MappingProxyType({})
+
+    def retain(
+        self,
+        payload: RetainPayload,
+        *,
+        policy_name: str | None = None,
+        resolution: LogicalResolution | None = None,
+    ) -> RetainDeclaration:
+        """Create/update a declaration after native validation and deduplication."""
+        if payload.tier != "gpu":
+            raise ControlError(
+                "unsupported", "Local declarations only bias GPU eviction"
+            )
+        if not isinstance(payload.target, (HashTarget, SessionTarget)):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "unresolved_target", "Resolve active requests before retaining"
+            )
+        follows = payload.scope == "follow_growth"
+        if follows and not (
+            isinstance(payload.target, SessionTarget)
+            and payload.target.continuation_id is not None
+        ):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "invalid_payload", "Growth requires a named continuation"
+            )
+        resolution = (
+            resolution if resolution is not None else self.index.resolve(payload.target)
+        )
+        if resolution.namespace != self.index.namespace:
+            raise ControlError(
+                "incompatible", "Retention snapshot belongs to another namespace"
+            )
+        self.expire()
+        key = payload.owner_id, payload.declaration_id
+        snapshot_keys = {content_key(b) for p in resolution.prefixes for b in p.blocks}
+        size = self._resolution_size(resolution)
+        if isinstance(payload.target, HashTarget):
+            size += len(payload.target.blocks)
+        incarnation = None
+        # Following declarations address the live common index, so they retain
+        # no historical snapshot of its potentially unbounded future growth.
+        if follows:
+            assert isinstance(payload.target, SessionTarget)
+            assert payload.target.continuation_id is not None
+            incarnation = self.index.get(
+                payload.target.session_id, payload.target.continuation_id
+            ).incarnation
+            snapshot_keys = set()
+            size = 0
+            resolution = LogicalResolution(
+                resolution.namespace, resolution.start_token, resolution.end_token, ()
+            )
+        count = self._snapshot_count - self._snapshot_sizes.get(key, 0) + size
+        if (
+            key not in self._declarations
+            and len(self._declarations) >= self.max_declarations
+        ) or count > self.max_snapshot_entries:
+            raise ControlError("capacity", "Retention declaration capacity exhausted")
+        self._remove(key)
+        self._generation += 1
+        expiry = (
+            None if payload.ttl_seconds is None else self._clock() + payload.ttl_seconds
+        )
+        declaration = RetainDeclaration(
+            payload.owner_id,
+            payload.declaration_id,
+            self._generation,
+            payload.priority,
+            expiry,
+            payload.target,
+            follows,
+            incarnation,
+            resolution,
+            policy_name,
+        )
+        self._declarations[key] = declaration
+        self._owners.setdefault(payload.owner_id, set()).add(key)
+        if follows:
+            assert isinstance(payload.target, SessionTarget)
+            assert payload.target.continuation_id is not None
+            continuation = payload.target.session_id, payload.target.continuation_id
+            self._following.setdefault(continuation, set()).add(key)
+        else:
+            self._snapshot_keys[key] = snapshot_keys
+            self._snapshot_sizes[key] = size

+                self._by_content.setdefault(content, {})[key] = payload.priority
+        self._snapshot_count = count
+        if expiry is not None:
+            heapq.heappush(self._expiry, (expiry, declaration.generation, key))
+        self._compact_expiry()
+        return declaration
+
+    def get(self, owner_id: str, declaration_id: str) -> RetainDeclaration | None:
+        self.expire()
+        return self._declarations.get((owner_id, declaration_id))
+
+    def coverage(self, owner_id: str, declaration_id: str) -> LogicalResolution:
+        declaration = self.get(owner_id, declaration_id)

+        priority = max(
+            self._by_content.get((group_id, block_hash), {}).values(), default=0
+        )

+            group_id, block_hash

+            for key in self._following.get(continuation, ()):
+                declaration = self._declarations[key]
+                target = declaration.target
+                state = self.index.get(*continuation)
+                if state.incarnation != declaration.continuation_incarnation:
+                    continue
+                if any(
+                    b.start_token >= target.start_token
+                    and (target.end_token is None or b.end_token <= target.end_token)
+                    for b in spans
+                ):
+                    priority = max(priority, declaration.priority)
+        return priority
+
+    def priority_snapshot(self) -> tuple[tuple[int, int], Mapping[ContentKey, int]]:
+        """Return a cached eviction view, invalidated by expiry or followed growth."""
+        self.expire()
+        version = (
+            self._generation,
+            self.index.content_revision if self._following else 0,
+        )
+        if version != self._projection_version:
+            priorities = {
+                key: max(values.values()) for key, values in self._by_content.items()
+            }
+            for continuation, keys in self._following.items():
+                try:
+                    state = self.index.get(*continuation)
+                except ControlError:
+                    continue
+                for key in keys:
+                    declaration = self._declarations[key]
+                    if state.incarnation != declaration.continuation_incarnation:
+                        continue
+                    target = declaration.target
+                    for block in state.blocks:
+                        if block.start_token >= target.start_token and (
+                            target.end_token is None
+                            or block.end_token <= target.end_token
+                        ):
+                            content = content_key(block)
+                            priorities[content] = max(
+                                priorities.get(content, 0), declaration.priority
+                            )
+            self._projection = MappingProxyType(priorities)
+            self._projection_version = version
+        return version, self._projection
+
+    def active_declarations(self) -> tuple[RetainDeclaration, ...]:
+        self.expire()
+        return tuple(self._declarations.values())
+
+    def release(self, owner_id: str, declaration_id: str) -> bool:
+        self.expire()
+        removed = self._remove((owner_id, declaration_id))
+        self._compact_expiry()
+        return removed
+
+    def finish_task(
+        self, session_id: str, *, expected_revision: int
+    ) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+        """Release the addressed owners before dropping their logical associations."""
+        if type(
+            expected_revision
+        ) is not int or expected_revision != self.index.session_revision(session_id):
+            raise ControlError("stale_revision", "Task tree changed before cleanup")
+        self.expire()
+        owners = self.index.task_tree(session_id)
+        owned = {key for owner in owners for key in self._owners.get(owner, ())}
+        closed = set(owners)
+        frozen: dict[DeclarationKey, LogicalResolution] = {}
+        for continuation, keys in self._following.items():
+            if continuation[0] in closed:
+                for key in keys - owned:
+                    declaration = self._declarations[key]
+                    if (
+                        self.index.get(*continuation).incarnation
+                        == declaration.continuation_incarnation
+                    ):
+                        frozen[key] = self.index.resolve(declaration.target)
+        count = self._snapshot_count - sum(
+            self._snapshot_sizes.get(k, 0) for k in owned
+        )
+        if (
+            count + sum(self._resolution_size(r) for r in frozen.values())
+            > self.max_snapshot_entries
+        ):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "capacity", "Cannot preserve another owner's closing prefix"
+            )
+        for owner in owners:
+            for key in tuple(self._owners.get(owner, ())):
+                self._remove(key)
+        for key, resolution in frozen.items():
+            declaration = self._declarations[key]
+            # Preserve another owner's effective scope and original expiry.
+            self._remove(key)
+            self._declarations[key] = replace(
+                declaration, follows_growth=False, snapshot=resolution
+            )
+            self._owners.setdefault(declaration.owner_id, set()).add(key)
+            self._snapshot_keys[key] = {
+                content_key(b) for p in resolution.prefixes for b in p.blocks
+            }
+            size = self._resolution_size(resolution)
+            self._snapshot_sizes[key] = size
+            self._snapshot_count += size
+            for content in self._snapshot_keys[key]:
+                self._by_content.setdefault(content, {})[key] = declaration.priority
+        self._compact_expiry()
+        return self.index.finish_task(session_id, expected_revision=expected_revision)
+
+    def prune(
+        self, session_id: str, continuation_id: str, *, expected_revision: int
+    ) -> None:
+        self.expire()
+        state = self.index.get(session_id, continuation_id)
+        if any(
+            self._declarations[k].continuation_incarnation == state.incarnation
+            for k in self._following.get((session_id, continuation_id), ())
+        ):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "busy", "A following declaration still uses this continuation"
+            )
+        self.index.prune(
+            session_id, continuation_id, expected_revision=expected_revision
+        )
+
+    def expire(self) -> None:
+        now = self._clock()
+        while self._expiry and self._expiry[0][0] <= now:
+            _, generation, key = heapq.heappop(self._expiry)
+            current = self._declarations.get(key)
+            if current is not None and current.generation == generation:
+                self._remove(key)
+        self._compact_expiry()
+
+    def _remove(self, key: DeclarationKey) -> bool:
+        declaration = self._declarations.pop(key, None)
+        if declaration is None:
+            return False
+        self._generation += 1
+        owner = self._owners[declaration.owner_id]
+        owner.remove(key)
+        if not owner:
+            del self._owners[declaration.owner_id]
+        if declaration.follows_growth:
+            target = declaration.target
+            assert (
+                isinstance(target, SessionTarget) and target.continuation_id is not None
+            )
+            continuation = target.session_id, target.continuation_id
+            following = self._following[continuation]
+            following.remove(key)
+            if not following:
+                del self._following[continuation]
+        else:
+            snapshot_keys = self._snapshot_keys.pop(key)
+            self._snapshot_count -= self._snapshot_sizes.pop(key)
+            for content in snapshot_keys:
+                priorities = self._by_content[content]
+                del priorities[key]
+                if not priorities:
+                    del self._by_content[content]
+        return True
+
+    def _check_continuation(self, declaration: RetainDeclaration) -> None:
+        target = declaration.target
+        assert isinstance(target, SessionTarget) and target.continuation_id is not None
+        state = self.index.get(target.session_id, target.continuation_id)
+        if state.incarnation != declaration.continuation_incarnation:
+            raise ControlError(
+                "missing_association", "Retained continuation was replaced"
+            )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _resolution_size(resolution: LogicalResolution) -> int:
+        return sum(
+            max(1, len(p.blocks) + len(p.partial_blocks) + len(p.missing_ranges))
+            for p in resolution.prefixes
+        )
+
+    def _compact_expiry(self) -> None:
+        if len(self._expiry) > max(64, 2 * len(self._declarations)):
+            self._expiry = [
+                (d.expires_at, d.generation, key)
+                for key, d in self._declarations.items()
+                if d.expires_at is not None
+            ]
+            heapq.heapify(self._expiry)

+                    if valid:
+                        if job.lease.direction == "load":
+                            movement.completed_holds.add(job.lease)
+                        movement.succeeded.add(job.lease.key)
+                        self._target_success(movement, job.lease.key)
+                    else:
+                        movement.errors[
+                            "missing" if completion.missing else "failed"
+                        ] += 1
+                        if completion.reason and len(movement.reasons) < 3:
+                            movement.reasons.append(completion.reason[:512])
+                        self._target_error(
+                            movement,
+                            job.lease.key,
+                            "missing" if completion.missing else "failed",
+                            completion.reason,
+                        )
+                    if not movement.pending:
+                        self._finish(movement)
+
+    def cancel_owners(self, owners: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
+        for movement in tuple(self._operations.values()):
+            if movement.owners.intersection(owners):
+                self._cancel(movement, "Task finished")
+
+    def cancel_operations(self, operation_ids: set[int], reason: str) -> None:
+        for operation_id in operation_ids:
+            movement = self._operations.get(operation_id)
+            if movement is not None:
+                self._cancel(movement, reason)
+
+    def conflicts_with_explicit(
+        self,
+        payload: NativePayload | Primitive,
+        keys: set[BlockHashWithGroupId],
+    ) -> bool:
+        for movement in self._operations.values():
+            if movement.operation.origin is not None or not movement.keys.intersection(
+                keys
+            ):
+                continue
+            if isinstance(payload, EvictPayload):
+                return True
+            if (
+                isinstance(payload, (RetainPayload, PrefetchPayload, SetPriority))
+                or (isinstance(payload, CopyTo) and payload.dst.tier == "gpu")
+            ) and isinstance(movement.payload, DemotePayload):
+                return True
+            if isinstance(payload, (DemotePayload, MoveTo)) and isinstance(
+                movement.payload, PrefetchPayload
+            ):
+                return True
+        return False
+
+    def _cancel(self, movement: _Movement, reason: str) -> None:
+        caller = movement.operation.operation_id
+        for job_id in movement.pending:
+            job = self._jobs[job_id]
+            job.callers.discard(caller)
+            self.resources.cancel(job.lease, caller)
+        for lease in movement.completed_holds:
+            self.resources.cancel(lease, caller)
+        self.registry.update(
+            movement.operation,
+            OperationStatus.CANCELLED,
+            reason=reason,
+            completed_steps=self._completed_steps(movement),
+            affected_blocks=len(movement.succeeded),
+            transferred_bytes=movement.transferred_bytes,
+            target_outcomes=tuple(
+                replace(outcome, status=OperationStatus.CANCELLED, reason=reason)
+                if outcome.status == OperationStatus.RECEIVED
+                else outcome
+                for outcome in movement.outcomes.values()
+            )
+            + movement.unresolved,
+        )
+        del self._operations[caller]
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _completed_steps(movement: _Movement) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+        if not movement.succeeded:
+            return ()
+        return (
+            ("gpu_content_registered",)
+            if isinstance(movement.payload, PrefetchPayload)
+            else ("cold_copy_stored",)
+        )
+
+    def _finish(self, movement: _Movement) -> None:
+        errors = movement.errors
+        pool = self.manager.block_pool
+        affected = len(movement.succeeded)
+        blocked = errors["capacity"] + errors["busy"]
+        if isinstance(movement.payload, PrefetchPayload):
+            lost = {
+                key
+                for key in movement.succeeded
+                if not pool.cached_block_hash_to_block.get_blocks(key)
+            }
+            movement.succeeded.difference_update(lost)
+            for key in lost:
+                self._target_error(
+                    movement,
+                    key,
+                    "missing",
+                    "Destination was displaced before operation completion",
+                )
+            errors["missing"] += len(lost)
+            affected = len(movement.succeeded)
+        steps = self._completed_steps(movement)
+        if isinstance(movement.payload, DemotePayload) and movement.succeeded:
+            eviction = pool.evict_unreferenced(movement.succeeded)
+            affected = eviction.num_evicted_blocks
+            blocked += len(eviction.blocked)
+            if eviction.evicted:
+                steps += ("gpu_copies_reclaimed",)
+            for key in movement.succeeded:
+                outcome = movement.outcomes[key]
+                movement.outcomes[key] = replace(
+                    outcome,
+                    status=OperationStatus.PARTIAL
+                    if key in eviction.blocked
+                    else OperationStatus.COMPLETED,
+                    completed_steps=outcome.completed_steps
+                    + (("gpu_copies_reclaimed",) if key in eviction.evicted else ()),
+                    reason="Source remains referenced"
+                    if key in eviction.blocked
+                    else "",
+                )
+        if movement.succeeded:
+            status = (
+                OperationStatus.PARTIAL
+                if sum(errors.values()) or blocked
+                else OperationStatus.COMPLETED
+            )
+        elif errors["failed"]:
+            status = OperationStatus.FAILED
+        elif blocked:
+            status = OperationStatus.DEFERRED
+        elif errors["missing"]:
+            status = OperationStatus.MISSING
+        elif errors["unsupported"]:
+            status = OperationStatus.UNSUPPORTED
+        elif sum(errors.values()):
+            status = OperationStatus.FAILED
+        else:
+            status = OperationStatus.COMPLETED
+        self.registry.update(
+            movement.operation,
+            status,
+            completed_steps=steps,
+            affected_blocks=affected,
+            transferred_bytes=movement.transferred_bytes,
+            blocked_targets=blocked,
+            missing_targets=errors["missing"] + errors["unsupported"],
+            target_outcomes=tuple(movement.outcomes.values()) + movement.unresolved,
+            reason="; ".join(movement.reasons)
+            or (
+                "Target coverage is incomplete"
+                if status != OperationStatus.COMPLETED
+                else ""
+            ),
+        )
+        for lease in movement.completed_holds:
+            self.resources.cancel(lease, movement.operation.operation_id)
+        del self._operations[movement.operation.operation_id]
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _target_success(movement: _Movement, key: BlockHashWithGroupId) -> None:
+        steps = (
+            ("gpu_content_registered",)
+            if isinstance(movement.payload, PrefetchPayload)
+            else ("cold_copy_stored",)
+        )
+        movement.outcomes[key] = replace(
+            movement.outcomes[key],
+            status=OperationStatus.COMPLETED,
+            completed_steps=steps,
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _target_error(
+        movement: _Movement, key: BlockHashWithGroupId, code: str, reason: str
+    ) -> None:
+        status = {
+            "capacity": OperationStatus.DEFERRED,
+            "busy": OperationStatus.DEFERRED,
+            "missing": OperationStatus.MISSING,
+            "unsupported": OperationStatus.UNSUPPORTED,
+        }.get(code, OperationStatus.FAILED)
+        movement.outcomes[key] = replace(
+            movement.outcomes[key], status=status, reason=reason[:512]
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _record_error(movement: _Movement, code: str, reason: str) -> None:
+        movement.errors[code] += 1
+        if len(movement.reasons) < 3:
+            movement.reasons.append(reason[:512])
